review_text: Prompt injection attacks exploit the inability of LLMs to distinguish between instruction (from a trusted system designer) and data (from an untrusted user) in their input [arXiv:2410.05451, стр. 1]. Existing defenses against prompt injection attacks try to explicitly enforce the separation between instruction and data via prompting or fine-tuning [arXiv:2410.05451, стр. 1]. Fine-tuning defenses, which are empirically validated to be stronger in prior work, adopt a training loss that maximizes the LLM’s likelihood of outputting the desirable response [arXiv:2410.05451, стр. 1]. Prompt injection is a test-time attack against LLM-integrated applications that maliciously leverages the instruction-following capabilities of LLMs, where the attacker seeks to manipulate LLMs into executing an injected instruction hidden in the data instead of the benign instruction specified by the system designer [arXiv:2410.05451, стр. 2]. A secure LLM should observe the response to the injected instruction and be steered away from that response, which can be formulated as preference optimization [arXiv:2410.05451, стр. 2]. Among recent progress, Chen et al. and Piet et al. show promising robustness against optimization-free prompt injections, but none of them are robust to optimization-based prompt injections [arXiv:2410.05451, стр. 3]. Wallace et al. introduces the instruction hierarchy, a generalization of previous work, which aims to improve robustness against prompt injection attacks [arXiv:2410.05451, стр. 3]. The wide application of LLMs, including interaction with third-party tools containing potential unsafe data, introduces new risks to building a safe LLM system [arXiv:2410.05451, стр. 11].

review_text: The Continuous Memory Machine (CMM) builds upon the Continuous Thought Machine (CTM) by introducing an explicit matrix-valued long-term memory (LTM) that operates alongside a sliding-window short-term memory (STM) [arXiv:2610.07907, стр. 4]. The CMM uses a Transformer to jointly update the STM and LTM, providing a mechanism for writing, retrieval, and reorganization of memories across both stores [arXiv:2610.07907, стр. 4]. The LTM in the CMM is defined as a matrix Bt ∈ R^d×ML, where ML columns are treated as tokens of dimension d, and it is initialized with a learned matrix B0 [arXiv:2610.07907, стр. 4]. The CMM enhances the CTM by augmenting its short-term temporal processing with a separately accessible persistent store, allowing it to leverage long-term memory when useful while retaining the ability to rely on short-term computation [arXiv:2610.07907, стр. 8]. Mnemosyne, an unsupervised, human-inspired long-term memory architecture, uses graph-structured storage, modular substance and redundancy filters, memory committing and pruning mechanisms, and probabilistic recall with temporal decay and refresh processes [arXiv:2510.08601, стр. 1]. Mnemosyne introduces a concentrated 'core summary' efficiently derived from a fixed-length subset of the memory, which is designed for edge-based large language models (LLMs) [arXiv:2510.08601, стр. 1].

review_text: Due to the rapid growth of the area, many papers on automated red teaming have developed their own evaluation setups to compare their methods against baselines [arXiv:2402.04249, стр. 2]. Among prior work, we find at least 9 distinct evaluation setups, which we show in Table 1 [arXiv:2402.04249, стр. 2]. We find that existing comparisons rarely overlap, and in Section 3.2 we demonstrate that prior evaluations are essentially incomparable across papers due to a lack of standardization [arXiv:2402.04249, стр. 2]. A wide variety of automated red teaming methods have been proposed for LLMs, including text optimization methods, LLM optimizers, and custom jailbreaking templates [arXiv:2402.04249, стр. 2]. These methods include text optimization methods (Wallace et al., 2019; Guo et al., 2021; Shin et al., 2020; Wen et al., 2023; Jones et al., 2023; Zou et al., 2023), LLM optimizers (Perez et al., 2022; Chao et al., 2023; Mehrotra et al., 2023), and custom jailbreaking templates [arXiv:2402.04249, стр. 2]. In prior work, a range of specialized evaluation setups have been proposed, but there has not yet been a systematic effort to standardize these evaluations and provide a large-scale comparison of existing methods [arXiv:2402.04249, стр. 4]. We identify three key qualities for automated red teaming evaluations: breadth, comparability, and robust metrics [arXiv:2402.04249, стр. 4]. The validation set contains 100 behaviors, and the test set contains 410 behaviors, selected with stratified sampling using the intersections between all functional behaviors and semantic categories, followed by manual adjustment [arXiv:2402.04249, стр. 18].

review_text: Evolutionary Computation (EC) has emerged as a powerful field of Artificial Intelligence, inspired by nature’s mechanisms of gradual development [arXiv:2310.08748, стр. 1]. However, EC approaches often face challenges such as stagnation, diversity loss, computational complexity, population initialization, and premature convergence [arXiv:2310.08748, стр. 1]. review_text: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) leverages external information to improve task performance by using the user’s input as a query to retrieve relevant documents, which are then provided to the LLM as contextual information [arXiv:2511.22858, стр. 4]. RAG helps in generating responses that are up-to-date and faithful to the context, addressing the issue of outdated information that can occur when relying solely on the model’s pre-training knowledge [arXiv:2511.22858, стр. 5]. In the context of RAG, the retrieval of relevant documents is crucial for generating accurate and contextually appropriate responses [arXiv:2511.22858, стр. 4]. A study on context compliance in RAG under knowledge conflict found that Standard RAG reaches 15.0% accuracy (± 3.1%, N=500 scored examples) when provided with the most common human misconception as the retrieved context [arXiv:2605.14473, стр. 7]. Context-Driven Decomposition (CDD) is introduced to study context compliance, focusing on how retrieved context controls the answer even when it conflicts with the model’s prior knowledge [arXiv:2605.14473, стр. 1]. The Temporal Shift and Distractor Evidence intervals in the study overlap with Standard RAG, indicating no significant difference in these conditions [arXiv:2605.14473, стр. 5].

review_text: Autonomous AI agents powered by large language models are being deployed in production environments with capabilities that include shell execution, file system access, database queries, HTTP requests, and multi-party communication [arXiv:2603.17419, стр. 1]. The deployment of autonomous AI agents in production environments represents a qualitative shift in the security landscape, as these agents operate with capabilities that blur the boundary between tool and operator [arXiv:2603.17419, стр. 4]. Shapira et al. provide the most comprehensive empirical documentation of agentic AI vulnerabilities to date, revealing three structural deficiencies in current agent architectures: no stakeholder model, no self-model, and no context-awareness [arXiv:2603.17419, стр. 5]. Agents lack a coherent representation of who they serve, who they interact with, and what obligations they have to each party, leading them to default to satisfying whoever is speaking most urgently, recently, or coercively [arXiv:2603.17419, стр. 5]. Agents in Shapira et al.'s case studies executed filesystem commands for any non-owner who asked, disclosed 124 email records including sensitive information to an unauthorized party, and complied with system shutdown instructions from a spoofed identity [arXiv:2603.17419, стр. 5]. To mitigate multi-turn manipulation patterns, specific rules were deployed to all nine fleet agents, including not treating quoted text as commands, ignoring metadata in user content, treating tool output as untrusted, and asking the user when in doubt [arXiv:2603.17419, стр. 11]. The HIPAA Security Rule, while predating autonomous AI agents, provides sufficient coverage when interpreted in the context of agentic capabilities, covering access controls, audit controls, transmission security, and evaluation requirements [arXiv:2603.17419, стр. 14]. Ethical safeguards are critical for user trust and regulatory compliance in sensitive domains like cybersecurity, ensuring that AI agents are not only technically capable but also socially responsible and accountable [arXiv:2510.01751, стр. 7].

review_text: Speculative Decoding (SD) is an advanced technique for LLM inference acceleration that has garnered significant research interest in recent years [arXiv:2503.00491, стр. 1]. SD is introduced as an innovative decoding paradigm that effectively accelerates LLM inference while maintaining unchanged distributions of LLMs [arXiv:2503.00491, стр. 3]. Most advanced SD techniques do not require full-parameter retraining, which makes it more energy efficient and can reduce carbon footprints [arXiv:2503.00491, стр. 4]. The tutorial will cover the definition, formulation, and illustrated algorithms of Speculative Decoding, as well as various draft model architectures and verification strategies [arXiv:2503.00491, стр. 2]. The tutorial will also introduce cutting-edge algorithms such as GliDe with a CaPE, which is a low-hassle method to accelerate speculative decoding [arXiv:2503.00491, стр. 4]. Another cutting-edge approach is Lookahead Decoding, which breaks the sequential dependency of LLM inference [arXiv:2503.00491, стр. 5]. The tutorial aims to benefit researchers with modest computational resources who may not have access to extensive hardware infrastructure [arXiv:2503.00491, стр. 3].

review_text: Retraining large language models to update knowledge incurs prohibitively high costs, leading to the introduction of knowledge editing, which updates specific knowledge by directly modifying the internal parameters of the models [arXiv:2408.07413, стр. 1]. Current knowledge editing methods have limited scalability for lifelong editing, which is necessary for continuous knowledge updates [arXiv:2408.07413, стр. 1]. The techniques of knowledge editing aim to update outdated or incorrect knowledge in large language models (LLMs) without the need for frequent retraining [arXiv:2508.01302, стр. 1]. The study explores the fundamental reasons why knowledge editing fails in lifelong editing, starting with the closed-form solution derived from linear associative memory, which underpins state-of-the-art knowledge editing methods [arXiv:2408.07413, стр. 1]. Future directions for knowledge editing include attempting knowledge editing in larger language models with sparser architectures and decomposing knowledge within models to perform more targeted edits [arXiv:2408.07413, стр. 7]. review_text: The forgetting of large language models (LLMs) during continual finetuning has received some attention in recent years, showing the importance of pretraining to mitigate forgetting [arXiv:2410.14159, стр. 3]. Exact Unlearning is a full retraining-based approach that ensures complete data removal by retraining from scratch, offering the strongest guarantees of compliance and reversibility, but it is computationally intensive and impractical for large-scale or continuously learning systems [arXiv:2509.10590, стр. 10]. Open-world forgetting, a phenomenon where a model forgets knowledge outside the scope of the training data, has been assessed by evaluating the performance of both the original unaltered model and the customized model on 10,000 user prompts from the DiffusionDB dataset [arXiv:2410.14159, стр. 5]. To demonstrate that open-world forgetting is a general phenomenon, the study analyzed three broad categories of model alterations: model customization, unlearning, and quantization methods [arXiv:2410.14159, стр. 15]. Machine Unlearning (MU) has emerged as a promising approach to addressing persistent challenges in responsible and adaptive AI, particularly in the context of large language models [arXiv:2509.10590, стр. 1].

The watermarking method is not only applicable to generated text but also to human-written text, thereby broadening its potential scope and utility [arXiv:2305.08883, стр. 11]. Watermarking techniques can maintain the original semantics of the text, even when applied to human-written content [arXiv:2305.08883, стр. 11]. Watermarking schemes can be broadly divided into two categories: pre-text watermarks and post-text watermarks [arXiv:2407.04794, стр. 13]. Format-based watermarks do not modify the content of the text but change the format of the text in ways that are imperceptible to humans [arXiv:2407.04794, стр. 4]. Watermarking techniques can achieve high-confidence detections when enough tokens are observed, such as detecting the watermark after observing 800 tokens on average with a 1e−5 false positive rate [arXiv:2306.04634, стр. 1]. The reliability of watermarking as a strategy to identify machine-generated text is investigated, focusing on whether watermarks remain detectable under various types of realistic corruptions [arXiv:2306.04634, стр. 2].

review_text: Post-training quantization is widely used in existing embedded hardware solutions, but most hardware-friendly post-training schemes have only managed to get decent performance at higher bit widths [arXiv:1911.07190, стр. 3]. The proposed method of post-training quantization with variable-length encoding (VLCQ) has a greater representational capability (lower quantization error in low-bit widths) compared to other schemes [arXiv:2610.15092, стр. 8]. Loss Aware Post-Training Quantization (LAPQ) jointly optimizes all quantization parameters by minimizing the loss function directly, which is particularly useful at low precision where the loss function is non-separable and has steep curvature [arXiv:1911.07190, стр. 14]. Hardware Friendly Post Training Quantization (HPTQ) is a three-tier method that adapts and combines several known quantization techniques for both weights and activations, achieving competitive results under hardware-friendly constraints [arXiv:2109.09113, стр. 17]. Symmetric uniform quantization with a fixed number of bits M and quantization step size ∆ is used to map continuous values into discrete representations, which is a key aspect of post-training quantization [arXiv:1911.07190, стр. 5]. HPTQ aims to quantize a trained floating-point network using hardware-friendly quantizers, which are uniform, symmetric, and have power-of-two thresholds, to ensure compatibility with existing hardware [arXiv:2109.09113, стр. 4].

A popular method to extend the context window is to modify positional encoding at inference, with RoPE-based scaling methods including linear interpolation and frequency-aware YaRN being notable approaches [arXiv:2510.00028, стр. 1]. RoPE introduces no additional asymptotic cost, as it is a per-token, per-head (sin, cos) rotation applied to dh/2 pairs, preserving the compute and memory complexity of scaled dot-product attention while endowing it with both absolute and relative position awareness [arXiv:2510.00028, стр. 3]. The low-frequency rotary components of RoPE carry the long-range semantic and positional signal, which is essential for context-length extension [arXiv:2606.21249, стр. 16]. YaRN and NTK-aware RoPE refinements are effective in extending the context window of large language models without significant performance degradation [arXiv:2510.00028, стр. 1]. The model's perplexity on long-context workloads can be improved by more than 14% using these context extension methods, while preserving short-context performance, inference throughput, and compatibility with existing LLM system stacks [arXiv:2510.00028, стр. 1].

review_text: Retrieval-augmented code generation (RACG) has been successfully applied in code generation, but existing pipelines employ static knowledge bases with a single source, limiting their adaptability [arXiv:2402.12317, стр. 1]. The current approach in retrieval-augmented code generation suffers from information redundancy and a preference gap, where the retrieved content may not align with the generator's needs [arXiv:2409.15895, стр. 1]. RRG, a novel retrieval-augmented code generation framework, addresses the issues of redundant information and the preference gap by integrating a refactor module to optimize code snippets [arXiv:2409.15895, стр. 11]. In the RRG framework, the input to the model includes the query and the cropped relevant code, which is processed and adjusted to a fixed length to facilitate the generation of the target code [arXiv:2409.15895, стр. 5]. To investigate the effectiveness of RRG, the ConCode dataset, characterized by short code snippets with high similarity, is used to simulate scenarios where significant noise can affect the generator [arXiv:2409.15895, стр. 7]. In the RAG approach, all retrieved information is directly provided to the generator, whereas in the RRG framework, the generator only receives optimized and relevant code snippets [arXiv:2409.15895, стр. 7].

review_text: The Reasoning-CV method is a two-stage fine-tuning process for open-source LLMs, designed to develop powerful reasoning LLMs for CoT-Verify [arXiv:2505.12348, стр. 2]. In the first stage of Reasoning-CV, GPT-4o is prompted to generate reliable reasoning paths for ground-truth labels, and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is performed on pre-trained open-source LLMs [arXiv:2505.12348, стр. 2]. In the second stage of Reasoning-CV, the fine-tuned LLM generates reasoning paths for each veracity option, and these paths are used to build preference pairs for DPO fine-tuning, emphasizing reasoning paths with the ground-truth veracity [arXiv:2505.12348, стр. 4]. Fine-tuning LLMs for claim verification with RL has faced Out-of-Memory problems, failing to run on a single H100-96 GPU [arXiv:2505.12348, стр. 8]. Reasoning-CV is able to condition the generated reasoning sequences for DPO on the different target veracities, which is not typically done in usual RL algorithms [arXiv:2505.12348, стр. 8]. Pre-trained open-source LLMs like the 8B LlaMA LLM tend to generate inferior reasoning paths compared to advanced black-box LLMs like GPT-4o [arXiv:2505.12348, стр. 4]. Other methods, such as PoT, PAL, and Gou et al., attempt to utilize external tools like code to avoid hallucination in the mathematical reasoning process, but they suffer from increased resource demands and greater time complexity [arXiv:2410.09008, стр. 3].

Recent studies have advanced the integration of citation intent classification with citation network analysis, which is typically treated as a separate task [arXiv:2505.21162, стр. 3]. GAN-BERT is particularly suited for citation intent classification in scenarios with limited annotated data, leveraging semi-supervised learning techniques [arXiv:2505.21162, стр. 11]. The inclusion of structural scaffolds in the model improves the representation of citation text and classification of its intent compared to the neural baseline [arXiv:1904.01608, стр. 7]. Single-layer label structures in citation intent classification frameworks can limit semantic clarity and hinder flexible reuse across diverse domains [arXiv:2601.05103, стр. 4].

Each section and sentence within the summaries generated by the AI Literature Review Suite has the appropriate APA citations that the user can refer back to [arXiv:2308.02443, стр. 6]. review_text: To push the limits of multimodal capability, the Scale up Visual Instruction Tuning (SVIT) dataset was constructed, containing 4.2 million visual instruction tuning data, including 1.6M conversation QA pairs, 1.6M complex reasoning QA pairs, 1.0M referring QA pairs, and 106K detailed image descriptions [arXiv:2307.04087, стр. 1]. The SVIT dataset is characterized by its high quality and rich diversity, generated by prompting G [arXiv:2307.04087, стр. 1]. In contrast to prior approaches that mix human-labeled data with GPT-4 synthesized data for visual instruction tuning, a two-stage instruction tuning pipeline is introduced in a recent study [arXiv:2402.11690, стр. 4]. The two-stage instruction tuning framework involves fine-tuning VLMs on VISION-FLAN, a dataset of 1,664,261 instances sourced from academic datasets, and further tuning on GPT-4 synthesized data [arXiv:2402.11690, стр. 1]. This two-stage tuning framework significantly outperforms the traditional single-stage visual instruction tuning framework and achieves state-of-the-art performance across a wide range of multi-modal tasks [arXiv:2402.11690, стр. 1]. StableLLaVA and VPG-C generate both images and texts using Stable Diffusion or Blended Diffusion to alleviate domain bias and encourage VLMs to attend to visual details [arXiv:2402.11690, стр. 8]. Recent work has also explored the use of negative instruction examples to improve robustness, addressing the bias introduced by positive instructions [arXiv:2402.11690, стр. 8]. End-to-end differentiable multimodal models, such as Flamingo, BLIP-2, Kosmos, MiniGPT-4, LLaVA, and InstructBLIP, input both vision and language tokens into LLMs, making them lightweight and concise for research [arXiv:2307.04087, стр. 2].

review_text: Chunking ensures that the retrieved data is precise and relevant, leading to better retrieval performance and higher-quality outputs in RAG systems [arXiv:2604.12047, стр. 3]. Effective information retrieval in RAG systems relies on accuracy, which involves selecting the most relevant data, and granularity, which ensures that the extracted content is appropriately sized [arXiv:2604.12047, стр. 3]. Several studies have emphasized the importance of chunking strategies in enhancing RAG performance, as the choice of chunk size and overlap can significantly influence context retention and retrieval quality [arXiv:2604.12047, стр. 3]. Recent work shows that static heuristics for chunking are often suboptimal, and several methods augment chunking strategies, such as recursive chunking, sliding window chunking, paragraph-based chunking, and semantic chunking [arXiv:2602.22225, стр. 3]. To rigorously assess the impact of chunking strategies on RAG performance, an evaluation setup was designed, isolating the effect of different chunking methods [arXiv:2603.25333, стр. 5]. The results from the evaluation provide actionable guidelines for building reliable and efficient RAG pipelines, demonstrating that lightweight parser–chunker choices already yield strong performance [arXiv:2604.12047, стр. 10].

The rapid growth in submissions to machine learning venues has strained the scientific peer-review system and intensified the need for AI-assisted review [arXiv:2605.26730, стр. 1]. Xu et al. (2025) incorporate retrieval of related papers, enabling models to identify missing baselines and citations [arXiv:2608.03581, стр. 2]. AAAI 2026 deployed an AI review pipeline for all main-track submissions [arXiv:2608.03581, стр. 2]. Prior work has identified limitations of AI-generated reviews, including a tendency to overrate borderline papers [arXiv:2608.03581, стр. 2]. The LLM-as-a-Judge produces textual rationales, a confidence level, and reviewer-oriented feedback [arXiv:2608.03581, стр. 17].
